filter_reference.job_type: Full Time / Part Time / Internship (UI filter)

extract_js: Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('a[href*="/remote-job/"]')).map(a => ({ href: a.href.split('?')[0], title: a.innerText?.slice(0, 120) || '' })).reduce((acc, x) => { if (!acc.find(y => y.href === x.href)) acc.push(x); return acc; }, []).slice(0, 20)
rules: Category pages are the reliable entry point — pick the category matching prompt roles
Keyword search exists but filters (experience, work mode) are UI-driven — apply them via browser, not URL, when needed
Fresh listings emphasized (24h turnaround) — good for Posting age <= 7 days prompts
notes: Seeded 2026-08-20 — category page verified live (55k+ software dev jobs listed)
Patch extract_js / search URL param on first live run if selector drift
